verdict.rationale: Apify docs confirm proxy rotation (datacenter/residential IPs) to avoid blocking, which is foundational for anti-bot evasion, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of automatic retry logic that chains through multiple proxies specifically upon detecting an anti-bot block (e.g., session retirement, retry-on-403 behavior in Crawlee/Apify Proxy). Missing for 10: explicit retry-chain mechanics tied to anti-bot detection, session pool rotation on failure, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific retry behavior.
